payload_en.headline: Telangana Congress asks Hyderabad police to investigate alleged mass voter deletion

paragraphs.text: Telangana Chief Electoral Officer C. Sudarshan Reddy directed district election officers on Monday to take action against applicants who knowingly make false statements or declarations in electoral forms.

Telangana had 3.39 crore voters before the special intensive revision process began on June 15, 2026, with draft voter lists removing 73.39 lakh voters and sending notices to 92 lakh voters, and the final voter list scheduled for publication on November 9.

Some booth level agents allegedly submitted fraudulent or pre-filled Form-7 documents, and the CEO's office took note of instances involving bulk Form-7 applications submitted before Electoral Registration Officers, with allegations that some of these applications were not genuine.
The police action occurred one day prior to the conclusion of claims and objections under the SIR process.
Form-7 is used to file an objection to the proposed inclusion or deletion of a name from the existing electoral roll.

On September 28, 2026, Bharatiya Janata Party booth level agent S. Balchandar took thirty pre-printed Form 7 applications to the booth level officer of polling station number 210. BJP booth-level agent S. Balachander brought 30 digitally pre-printed Form-7 applications to Polling Station No. 210 at Surya Nagar in Chikkadpally on September 28 at around 11.30 a.m.

BJP booth-level agent S. Balachander attempted to bring 30 pre-printed Form 7s and hand them over to the BLO at polling station number 210 on 28 September 2026. BJP booth-level agent S. Balachander left the forms at the polling station premises before the BLO and left the place on September 28. The BLO and BLO Supervisor refused to receive the bulk submission of Form-7 applications and did not issue an acknowledgement on September 28.

The BLO and BLO Supervisor submitted a field inspection report to the election authorities on September 30. The assistant electoral registration officer and electoral registration officer verified the case on October 1. This was the first instance of bulk Form-7 applications which came to light in Telangana on October 1.

Musheerabad electoral registration officer T. Pravin Kumar Reddy filed a complaint resulting in a First Information Report against Bharatiya Janata Party booth level agent S. Balchandar at Chikkadpally police station before 7 October 2026. An FIR was registered against BJP Booth Level Agent S. Balachander at Chikkadapally Police Station based on a complaint by an election official prior to Tuesday 06 October 2026. The Chikkadpally police in Hyderabad registered a case against BJP booth-level agent S. Balachander on Tuesday, October 6, 2026.

Musheerabad Assembly constituency electoral registration officer T. Pravin Kumar Reddy lodged a complaint against BJP booth-level agent S. Balachander following directions from the district election officer recently. The Chikkadpally police booked BJP booth-level agent S. Balachander under BNS Sections 217 and 318 (2) and Section 31 of the Representation of People Act recently. Election officials file a police complaint regarding the submission of fraudulent Form-7 applications recently.

A First Information Report is registered at the Chikkadpally police station in the Musheerabad assembly constituency of Hyderabad against BJP booth level agent S. Balachandar recently. Telangana Congress leaders approached Chief Electoral Officer C. Sudarshan Reddy earlier, alleging that BJP Booth Level Agent S. Balachander had submitted Form-7 applications seeking deletion of 30 electors. Hyderabad Police registered an FIR against BJP booth level agent S. Balachandar for submitting fake Form 7 applications prior to 6 October 2026.

Musheerabad electoral registration officer T. Pravin Kumar Reddy filed a complaint against BJP booth level agent S. Balachandar prior to 6 October 2026. Similar forms containing pre-printed voter information were found in Hyderabad's Bahadurpura and Goshamahal constituencies. This is the first FIR registered in Telangana over allegedly false information submitted through Form-7 during the Special Intensive Revision.

BJP booth-level agent S. Balachander acted with the malafide intention of deleting voters not connected to him. Some mobile numbers used to fill these forms on the Election Commission's online platform were found to be linked to Andhra Pradesh. This case is the first FIR registered in Telangana over allegations of submitting Form-7 applications containing false information. Police invoked relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Representation of the People Act in the FIR.

BJP Booth Level Agent S. Balachander submitted Form-7 applications seeking deletion of 30 electors during the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Congress leader stated that BJP booth level agent-2 Deepak Singh submitted 136 Form-7 applications with fraudulent signatures in the Subedhar Palya area of Bengaluru.

BJP Booth Level Agent S. Balachander filed false Form-7 applications seeking the deletion of 30 voters from the electoral rolls during the Special Intensive Revision. BJP booth level agent S. Balachandar submitted Form 7 applications containing pre-printed names of 30 Muslim individuals to remove them from the voter list. Congress leader stated that BJP booth level agent-2 Deepak Singh submitted 136 Form-7 applications with fraudulent signatures in the Subedhar Palya area of Bengaluru.

The case was registered based on a complaint submitted by T. Pravin Kumar, Electoral Registration Officer (ERO) of the 57-Musheerabad Assembly Constituency and Deputy Commissioner of GHMC Circle-41. BJP booth-level agent S. Balachander attempted to submit 30 pre-printed Form-7 applications seeking deletion of voters from the electoral roll. The 30 Form-7 applications had been signed by BJP booth-level agent S. Balachander himself.

Verification found that all 30 electors whose names were mentioned in the Form-7 applications were residing at the respective premises recorded in the electoral records, and the applications were therefore not accepted and liable to be rejected. Form-7 is utilized specifically for the purpose of removing someone's name from the voter list. The names of the concerned voters had already been printed on the Form 7 applications submitted by S. Balachander.

One of the 30 people against whom S. Balachander submitted Form 7 applications to have their names removed from the electoral roll is also a Congress BLA. Personal verification conducted on 1 October revealed that all 30 people named by the BLA were residents of Musheerabad in Hyderabad. Among the 30 individuals targeted in the Form 7 applications submitted by S. Balachandar is a Congress booth level agent.
The Congress lodged a complaint with Chief Electoral Officer Sudharshan Reddy demanding a thorough and impartial investigation on October 1.
Telangana Congress approached Hyderabad Police Commissioner V C Sajjanar seeking registration of an FIR and an SIT probe into suspected large-scale voter deletion on Monday.

Ramchandar Rao denying any attempt by the party to remove voters' names.

All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen chief Asaduddin Owaisi claimed that pre-printed Form 7 applications were filed to remove Muslim voters in Goshamahal assembly constituency and demanded action against individuals, which was answered by Bharatiya Janata Party state president N. The BJP BLA in Musheerabad Assembly constituency submitted Form-7 applications seeking deletion of the names of BJP BLA Sharfuddin and members of his family, according to Telangana Congress.

Political opponents of the Bharatiya Janata Party stated that pre-printed forms were centrally prepared and issued from the party office.

Congress Election Commission co-ordination committee chairman P. Rajesh Kumar stated that BJP booth-level agent S. Balachander is only the scapegoat and the police have to book the real culprits behind the printing, data collection, and supply of pre-printed Form-7s.
The applications submitted by BJP Booth Level Agent S. Balachander amounted to an attempt to unlawfully remove genuine voters from the electoral rolls, according to Telangana Congress leaders.

paragraphs.text: तेलंगाना के मुख्य निर्वाचन अधिकारी सी. सुदर्शन रेड्डी ने सोमवार को जिला निर्वाचन अधिकारियों को उन आवेदकों के खिलाफ कार्रवाई करने का निर्देश दिया जो चुनावी फॉर्म में जानबूझकर गलत बयान या घोषणाएं करते हैं।

15 जून, 2026 को विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण प्रक्रिया शुरू होने से पहले तेलंगाना में 3.39 करोड़ मतदाता थे, जिसमें मसौदा मतदाता सूची से 73.39 लाख मतदाताओं को हटाया गया और 92 लाख मतदाताओं को नोटिस भेजे गए, और अंतिम मतदाता सूची 9 नवंबर को प्रकाशित होने वाली है।

कुछ बूथ लेवल एजेंटों ने कथित तौर पर धोखाधड़ी वाले या पहले से भरे हुए फॉर्म-7 दस्तावेज जमा किए, और सीईओ कार्यालय ने निर्वाचक रजिस्ट्रीकरण अधिकारियों के समक्ष जमा किए गए थोक फॉर्म-7 आवेदनों से जुड़े मामलों का संज्ञान लिया, जिसमें आरोप है कि इनमें से कुछ आवेदन वास्तविक नहीं थे।
पुलिस कार्रवाई SIR प्रक्रिया के तहत दावों और आपत्तियों के समापन से एक दिन पहले हुई।
फॉर्म-7 का उपयोग मौजूदा मतदाता सूची में किसी नाम को शामिल करने या हटाने के प्रस्ताव पर आपत्ति दर्ज करने के लिए किया जाता है।

एआईएमआईएम प्रमुख असदुद्दीन ओवैसी ने सीईओ से आग्रह किया कि मुसलमानों के खिलाफ नफरत फैलाने वाले किसी भी व्यक्ति को न बख्शा जाए।
भाजपा प्रदेश अध्यक्ष एन. रामचंद्र राव ने कांग्रेस पर चुनाव आयोग जैसी संवैधानिक संस्था के खिलाफ जनता को गुमराह करने का आरोप लगाया।
एस. बालाचंदर के खिलाफ एफआईआर राज्य में मतदाता सूची के लिए एसआईआर के दावों और आपत्तियों के चरण के समाप्त होने से एक दिन पहले दर्ज की गई।
